steps.title: Add a torus
steps.instructions: In a new General scene, delete the cube and add a torus with Shift+A > Mesh > Torus.

steps.title: Shape the donut
steps.instructions: Adjust the torus major and minor radius in the Add Torus panel so it looks like a donut.

steps.title: Add subdivision surface
steps.instructions: Add a Subdivision Surface modifier and shade smooth.

steps.title: Make the icing
steps.instructions: Duplicate the top faces with Shift+D, separate them with P, and add a Solidify modifier.
